scope: Baked DAT per-vertex world light, additive radial light composition and replacement model light sampling; no renderer or gameplay code imported

references.purpose: CF_NORUNTIME Light/DirLight/GlobalDirLight/ObjectLight classes and brush lighting properties: world light is preprocessed, DirLight is a cone and GlobalDirLight lights only the world.
FLAG_NOLIGHT (object color and global light scale only) and FLAG_SHADOW definitions.
SetObjectColor documented as brightening a model's shading; GetPointShade exists but is not implemented here.
Client reads ModelAddR/G/B and ModelDirAddR/G/B server variables and truncates them into the ModelAdd/ModelDirAdd console commands; LightMap 0 option.
Default TintColor 0 passed to SetObjectColor, corroborating additive model color.
Later-generation surface flag bits (SURF_BRIGHT, SURF_FLATSHADE, SURF_LIGHTMAP, SURF_GOURAUDSHADE) matching the v56 flags observed in retail worlds.
Later-generation baker: vertex colors computed for every polygon including lightmapped ones, ambient as the starting value, 20-unit default lightmap grid.
Later-generation composition (lightmap + dynamic lights) * texture, consulted for the additive radial light order.
Later-generation Gouraud path: vertex color, then dynamic lights, then texture multiply.
Later-generation model light setup (light grid ambient, ranked static/dynamic lights), consulted to document what the replacement sampler does not reproduce.

adaptations: DAT v56 per-vertex RGB is read as baked light including world ambient, established by retail data analysis rather than an original reader.
Model light is sampled from the baked face light below each model with a presentation-owned BVH; it replaces the unavailable original model shading service and is not retail parity.
ModelDirAdd is read but not applied until model normals are available.
